```{r, include=FALSE}
text <- readLines("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LewisAJones/cv-markdown/refs/heads/main/README.md")
start <- grep(pattern = "Peer-reviewed publications", x = text)
end <- grep(pattern = "Meeting report: 13<sup>th</sup> International Symposium of Fossil Cnidaria and Porifera", x = text)
text <- text[start:end]
text <- gsub(pattern = "###", replacement = "#", x = text)
write(x = text, file = "_content.md")
```
